english.title: Fail to register a foreign influence arrangement
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) having made a foreign influence arrangement with a foreign power, namely **(..SPECIFY FOREIGN POWER..), failed to register that arrangement with the Secretary of State, before the end of the period of 28 days
english.legislation: Contrary to sections 69(5) and 80(3) of the National Security Act 2023.
english.pointstoprove:
date and location
made a foreign influence arrangement with a foreign power
failed to register that arrangement with the Secretary of State within 28 days of its making
knowing that the arrangement was a foreign influence arrangement

investigatoraction.description: DNA Samples: If crime scene stain present - take evidential sample If no crime scene stain and DNA not confirmed on PNC - take Criminal Justice sample. If DNA confirmed on PNC - CJ sample not required
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes: Where a person is not aware, or could not have reasonably known, that their arrangement is with a foreign power, they are not guilty of this offence (sections 69(5)).

other.penalty:
Either way
Summary: maximum 6/12 months imprisonment and / or fine.
Indictment : maximum 2 years imprisonment and / or fine.

The maximum penalty on summary conviction depends on the general limit in a magistrates’ court and may be 6 or 12 months depending on the date of conviction, see section 224(1) and (1A) of the Sentencing Act 2020.​​​​​​​

None
